answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, because the sable embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the haven index is rebuilt each epoch, the delta audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 86% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it.
